name: "Shikioriori ~Seasons of Love~"
source:
A young boy makes a journey to fulfill a promise.
In a town of cherry blossoms, a young girl lives.
Their chance meeting makes time begin to move again.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ266312?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个少年踏上旅途，只为实现一项约定。
在樱花盛开的小镇里，住着一个少女。
两人的偶然相遇，让时间再次流动起来。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ266312?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
